From the PEAK team · Austin Laudenslager, founder

1Every price is on the website

You can see the price and full specs of every PEAK sauna without giving your name or phone number, and without talking to a salesperson.

Eleven models, from the 2-person Crown at $4,950 to the 4-person outdoor El Capitan at $16,750.

Shop saunas Text us

2Full spectrum infrared on every model

Every PEAK sauna covers near, mid and far infrared, 700–25,000nm. You do not have to choose one type of heat.

On the Fuji and Everest, eight infrared heater panels surround you in a 360° layout.

Shop saunas Text us

3Red light therapy is standard, not an add-on

Medical-grade red light therapy is included standard. Most models carry one panel; the Denali, Matterhorn and El Capitan carry two.

Sit 7–8 inches from the panel and you get red light and infrared heat in one session.

Shop saunas Text us

4A size for your space, from 1 to 5 people

The 1-person Mini is 31.1 in wide, 31.9 in deep and 66.9 in tall. It plugs into a standard 120V/15A outlet, so you do not need an electrician.

At the other end, the 5-person Kilimanjaro is built for outdoors and runs on a dedicated 240V/30A circuit installed by an electrician.

Shop saunas Text us

5Free shipping, delivered on an appointment

Shipping is free, always, in the continental US. Your sauna ships in a PeakGuard custom wooden crate from our warehouse in Ontario, California.

  • In-stock orders ship within 2–4 business days.
  • The carrier calls 1–2 days before delivery to set a 4-hour window.
  • Curbside delivery is standard; white-glove or garage delivery is available for an extra fee.
Shop saunas Text us

6A 7-year residential warranty, in writing

7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page.

  • Heating elements and cabinetry: 7 years from delivery.
  • Control system, power supply and red light panels: 3 years.
  • Chromotherapy lighting, audio and WiFi/app: 1 year.

It covers parts for the original purchaser and is registered automatically when you order.

Shop saunas Text us

7Owning one comes with a club

Peak Wellness Club is included free with every PEAK sauna:

  • Expert protocols, with the temperature, duration, timing and breathwork for each one.
  • A leaderboard with live streak tracking.
  • The Sauna Lounge, a private community of owners.

Owners can also join Peak Longevity Lab after purchase. PEAK saunas may be eligible for HSA/FSA purchase through Redo.
